notes: Market vertical picks the compliance sector and optional ava-role profile. If unknown, the agent must ask the facilitator/customer before final legal readouts.

general-commercial.label: General commercial / cross-industry
general-commercial.description: Private-sector customer service, sales, or support without regulated health, government, or lending decisions.

financial-services.label: Financial services / banking / lending
financial-services.description: Credit, accounts, payments, fraud — ECOA/FCRA, PCI, GLBA themes in scope.

insurance-health.label: Health insurance / payer
insurance-health.description: Claims, prior auth, coverage — HIPAA, CMS, NAIC, UR.

insurance-pc.label: Property & casualty / commercial insurance
insurance-pc.description: Auto, home, commercial lines — NAIC AI governance; not clinical HIPAA unless PHI appears.

government-public.label: US government — federal, state, or local
government-public.description: Agency, public-sector cloud — FedRAMP §3.10, OMB, CJIS, IRS 1075 / §3.11.

telecom-outbound.label: Telecom / outbound campaigns
telecom-outbound.description: Robocalls, SMS, AI voice outbound — TCPA and state mini-TCPA in scope.

domain-brokerage.label: Domain brokerage / confidential acquisition
domain-brokerage.description: GoDaddy-style DBS routing — defers lending, hiring, health-insurance UR false positives.

retail-ecommerce.label: Retail / e-commerce
retail-ecommerce.description: Orders, returns, consumer chat — BOT disclosure, privacy, accessibility.

education.label: Education / EdTech
education.description: Students and guardians — COPPA and companion-chat rules where minors appear.
